learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish analytical warehousing workloads from transactional ones and choose a layered architecture
Design star-schema dimensional models with a declared, consistent grain
Apply surrogate keys and slowly-changing-dimension techniques to preserve history
Plan loading, partitioning and performance strategies for a warehouse
